calls.body: Major indexes remain near elevated levels but are facing increased short-term pressure as the 10-Year Treasury Yield moves above 5%. The combination of a 5.01% Treasury yield, elevated energy prices, increased volatility, geopolitical uncertainty, and stretched valuations increases the probability of continued sector rotation, profit-taking, and short-term pullbacks rather than uninterrupted market advances.
